results.title: First visit loads the shell with no errors
results.expected: Exercise tab, picker and both start buttons; no console or page errors
results.actual: shell ready; DCL 303 ms, load 305 ms

results.title: [sim] Complete session saves once and shows triage for that session
results.expected: +1 session row; outcome card lists agent tool calls; run log has a run for that session id
results.actual: session 197 saved once (3 reps, source simulation); 5 tool calls recorded for it; 1 POST

results.title: [stub] Save fails with 500, then retry
results.expected: error shown, reps kept, a retry control saves exactly one row

results.title: [stub] Response lost after the server wrote the session, then retry
results.actual: server deduplicated the retry: one row

results.title: [stub] Save answers 503
results.expected: clear message, no crash, retry available
results.actual: "The server could not save the session (HTTP 503). Try again in a moment. Your reps are kep" + retry

results.title: [stub] Malformed 200 response to save
results.expected: no crash; error shown; data not lost
results.actual: "The server answered in an unexpected format, so the save could not be confirmed." + retry

results.title: [stub] Offline at save time, back online, retry
results.expected: error while offline; one row after reconnect
results.actual: offline: "No connection to the app. Check the network, then "; one row after reconnect

results.title: [sim] Switching patient mid-session
results.expected: reps of patient A are never saved to patient B

results.title: [sim] Refresh mid-session
results.expected: no partial row written; app reloads clean

results.title: [sim] Back-to-back sessions and stale results
results.expected: second session starts clean; the first result never reappears over it
results.actual: no stale outcome over the running session

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Stop releases the camera and the loop
results.expected: all tracks ended; inference rAF stops

results.title: [synthetic-cam][stub] Model file fails to load
results.expected: error shown and the camera is released
results.actual: "The vision model could not load. Check the connection and try again, o"; camera released

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Camera disconnects mid-session
results.expected: the app says the camera stopped, stops the loop, and offers a way forward
results.actual: "The camera stopped (unplugged, turned off, or taken by another app). Start it ag"; loop stopped

results.title: [synthetic-cam][stub] Leave the Exercise tab while the camera request is pending
results.expected: the late camera grant is released immediately; no hidden camera
results.actual: camera granted after leaving was released; rAF 0/s

results.title: [synthetic-cam]+[sim] What leaves the browser during camera use and a saved session
results.expected: only same-origin app API and static assets; the session POST carries scored numbers only

results.title: Ask: prompt injection and markup in the question
results.expected: treated as text; no dialog; no data change; answer says what it can answer
results.actual: no dialog; 4 patients unchanged; rule-based answers rendered as text

results.title: Add patient: wrong code, then demo code
results.expected: wrong code refused; 2026 creates the patient and selects them
results.actual: refused ("That clinic code is not valid. Ask your "), then created and selected "QA Patient (me)"
